Tiffany & Co. (TIF) Analysts See $0.84 EPS
May 16, 2018 - By Jan Rainey
Analysts expect Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report $0.84 EPS on May, 23 before the open.They anticipate $0.10 EPS change or 13.51 % from last quarter’s $0.74 EPS. TIF’s profit would be $104.58M giving it 30.94 P/E if the $0.84 EPS is correct. After having $1.67 EPS previously, Tiffany & Co.’s analysts see -49.70 % EPS growth. The stock increased 2.04% or $2.08 during the last trading session, reaching $103.96. About 1.19 million shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) Ratings Coverage
Among 15 analysts covering Tiffany & Co ( NYSE:TIF ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 53% are positive. Tiffany & Co had 20 analyst reports since November 21, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy” on Sunday, March 18. The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co on Wednesday, January 17 with “Buy”. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, November 30 by Cowen & Co. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Friday, May 4 report. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, January 17 by Wells Fargo. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, January 17 by Susquehanna. On Wednesday, November 29 the stock rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Hold”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Loop Capital given on Thursday, April 5. As per Friday, December 1, the company rating was upgraded by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The stock of Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Monday, March 19.
Tiffany & Co., through its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and retails jewelry and other items worldwide. The company has market cap of $12.94 billion. The Company’s jewelry products include fine and solitaire jewelry; engagement rings and wedding bands; and non-gemstone, sterling silver, and gold jewelry. It has a 35.12 P/E ratio. The firm also sells timepieces, leather goods, sterling silverware, china, crystal, stationery, fragrances, and accessories.
